testcase.name: TC-016 Business Master frontend service > 宣告 registry name，並把 Currency 清單映射為 DataTable 形狀
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Currency create/update 只傳契約允許欄位，寫入一律啟用 idempotency
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Currency 高影響操作先 preview，再以 token、reason、version 執行
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > 高影響命令可沿用 caller-supplied idempotency key 查回未知結果
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Payment Term 清單映射為 DataTable 形狀
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Payment Term create/update 與規則變更符合契約
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Payment Term due date preview 傳 baseDate 與 expectedVersion
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > activate/deactivate 與 audit filter 使用明確端點
TC-016 Business Master frontend service > Business Master 的穩定錯誤碼都有中文訊息
